company_info.company_name: RK Solar And Consulting Services Pty Ltd

reviews.review_description: We had extra solar panels and a battery installed by RK Solar just over two years ago. We have had ongoing trouble with the system and high energy bills since then. The customer service has been slow to respond and the technicians they have sent have failed to rectify the problems. Although there was no mention of a problem that we are in the Shoalhaven area when they quoted for the installation, they now charge exorbitant call out fees when asked to rectify problems. Now we have identified that the current problem with the micro-inverters is under warranty, they agreed to waive the cost of repairs but said it will be more than two months before they can send a technician. Steer well clear of RK Solar!

RK Solar successfully installed ~6kW of additional panels (on enphase micro inverters) and a Tesla Powerwall 2. We have three phase power so we wanted the additional panels on the Enphase micro inverters as well as most of the house wired to one particular phase (to allow for backup protection and self charging during a grid failure). They were able to do this.Almost 3 years down the track, the system continues to function well.Only one small drawback. At the end of their installation, the house wasn't protected by RCDs. I had to get another electrician to install RCDs to all the circuits. For safety purposes (as well as to allow for another small source of revenue) RK solar should have also installed the RCDs to make the house also immediately safe rather than relying on the consumer to source another electrician for the job.The Tesla app works well. The enphase app isn't working perfectly. Perhaps it wasn't wired up correctly.

Aside from initial discussion with their salesman, the entire episode has been nothing short of atrocious.Initially, we were happy to have solar panels installed. We were asked to refer them other potential customers and if they install a solar system there would be a "bonus" for us - We referred two other customers, it took in excess of 50 phone calls and a mountain of emails before any bonus was received (BTW a $150 shopping voucher - its the principle)Their web site also advises of such a bonus, and goes further to advise that amount of bonus is available on any number (all) referrals. Several months of promises which led to nothing.Finally spoke with their principle/owner who advised that he would only pay one bonus per person (we had referred 2). When pointed out to him that this was not what was advised, nor what is advertised on their web site. He claimed that he was not aware of what was on web site - but would honour payments as we were "good" customers and as a gesture of good faith.I suggested that he really reconsider his statement as we had an email from his company (Operations Manager) confirming receipt of installation of the two referred customers, this, in addition to information freely available on web site.We eventually (nearly 12 month's later received the gift vouchers).Since installation,. the system continued to disconnect from its internet connection hence, not providing a reading of the panels' performance.Several emails and mountains of telephone calls eventually resulted in one of their technician coming across (their office and our house are some 2 klm apart). He was not able to reconnect to internet. Eventually with help of the Enphase help desk he was able to reconnect.System continued to disconnect continuously and with the help of a technician from another company we were able to reconnect it. Why a technician from another company?- RK solar do not respond to email (nor their principle)- RK Solar do not return telephone calls (nor their principle)When eventually we did make contact, they (including their principle) assured me that they had returned telephone calls and we did not pick-up. I advised that  there were no missed calls on my mobile, there were no phone messages left (BTW this is my work phone - I cannot afford to miss, overlook or not return a missed call or message).I asked that they provide telephone listing - in a digital world this should not be a problem. Believe it or not, their telephone system resets itself weekly?, monthly? - He (The principle) was not sure how often but, it had reset itself that day as such, no records to provide proof of phone calls.He agreed to send a technician out to have a look at it once again and re-connect system. The technician that he sent was not able to re-connect without the help of the Enphase helpdesk.We were then advised that issue was our internet system. Notwithstanding that we operated 3 lap tops, 3 televisions, 4 mobile telephones and a hand set (my wife and I work from home, cannot do so without internet). He was adamant that issue was with our internet.We paid out our existing contract and contracted to a new provider. Same issue - everything at home worked but, the solar system would not remain connected.After several attempts to contact, principle advised that  he would send technician out to us at a cost of $250-00, as the issue was with our internet. Explained that we had changed provider - He advised that would send technician free of cost for the last time.Again, technician took over an hour to reconnect and not without the help of the help desk.We were advised that issue was with our internet and we needed to change again.We had NBN (fibre optic) cables put in the house by an electrician at a cost of $1,200-00. Cancelled new contract and installed Telstra NBN (cabled).Still disconnected - everything else was fine.All of this time I kept telling them (principle and technicians) that we had been advised by The "other" technician that had helped us early in piece (from another company) that it was his opinion that Enphase/solar system be looked at as he did not feel it was working as it should be.On many occasion they assured me that it was the internet, not the system and they had the best technicians.When I threatened to take matter to Fair Trade, they agreed to replace the equipment.Guess what! the new equipment they installed, connected immediately, has not disconnected once and it works fantastically.This company and its principle lack any form of customer service, are misleading, do not return telephone calls, do not reply to emails.This company has cost us time and money above the cost of the solar system itself and we are so disappointed we chose them. We have had no contact from them, nor an apology.Please keep away

The whole experience from discussing requirements to the excellent and professional quote.The installation was done promptly and the site left spotless.The battery worked perfectly.The follow up on installation to make sure everything was done as agreed,

RK Solar installed 30kW of Jinko panels, 25kW Sungrow hybrid inverter and 40kWh battery on my shed. They were one of few installers who came to look at the job before quoting a very competitive price. The Sungrow kit had just been released on the market so RKS needed to do quite a lot of technical research before the installation. They did a very neat installation job and communicated well every step of the way. With new tech a few teething issues are expected and RKS followed through until everything was working well.Great job. No hesitation recommending RK Solar.

The sales rep was helpful and responsive and after a few Q&A interactions we felt confident in the system we chose.The installation was fast and efficient and the back office communication was very good too.We had a minor issue after the install because we have several trees nearby and wanted to ensure that no leaf litter gathered under the solar array. RK did a good job of installing the leaf netting but because our roof tiles are undulating rather than flat there were still gaps where the tiles had valleys. We ended up resolving this issue ourselves by plugging the gaps.We are still waiting for our grid provider to provide us with a Smart meter but this is due to happen next week.

They are a great team - Karan, Hemaal, Fahad and Blake. Highly knowledgeable, very professional in every step, right from sales to the installation and the system walkthrough. Karan brought Enphase professionals to be onsite during the installation to speak to me in case of any questions. RK Solar were on-site to assess the roof and came up with correct system size and provided the quote. They were never pushy. Offered me best advice. They have their in-house team of installers. Highly recommend them.

RK Solar were punctual, pleasant and efficient.Their trucks/ vans did not leak oil, which says quite a bit about the company taking pride in their workmanship.The installation went seamlessly.The follow up after installation was very professional.I will get them to install another battery under the pending incentives.

The entire process from the initial consult to the installation and handover was extremely seamless and professional. Hemaal, Karan, Fahad, Asish and the rest of the installation team were very polite, professional and kept you informed. I would recommend them to any potential customer looking for a Solar install. I personally had the 10.56 kW enphase system installed and it is paying dividends already. The team are to be commended for the courtesy and professionalism.
Sales process and installation was smooth and problem free. RK Solar took care of the grid connection, and helped set up the app so I could see usage and amount sent to the grid.

Highly recommend RK Solar. I had requested quotes from several companies using Solar Quotes and only RK Solar phoned to make an appointment, came down to check our switchboard and discuss our needs. The quote was prepared at our home and the sales person was able to answer my questions (note I received quotes from other companies, I asked questions about the set-up of panels on the roof, namely some wanting to install panels on the south & south-east without getting answers). Price was good & competitive. The installation took place on the date agreed, the work was neat: cables were installed in the cavity, some of our roof tiles needed to be replaced which was carried out, job was done in 1 day: we have a system with 30 panels on 3 different areas on the roof. We have today a system installed & working, easy to monitor so recommending RK Solar, they obviously are experienced and carried out a good job.
Installation company was professional and reliableI would recommend them with no hesitation
By far the best price for what I ended up wanting.Small hickup after installation was very quickly fixed.System working great since.
Easy sales quote and installation within a couple of weeks

RK Solar came around, a must for us to have someone to chat with. Phil reviewed the location, discussed options and built several options on the laptop for us to review. Communication was very good from quote to time of installation. Jordan and the team were tidy, install went well even though we had some extra work to do changing 2 Phase to single phase. Grid connection was organised after install.  Only fault was the communication re the process after solar is installed and what happens next. Probably should have been done at sales time, and surely straight after. Should be a checklist to inform the customer.  i.e. customer doesn't need to do anything, installation electrician provides info to RK Solar, then RK Solar send details to your provider, the provider then organises a smart meter with you(if required) to enable the FiT and the solar plan to move to. However overall quite happy after the first month.

The sales and quoting process was excellent with the sales person happy to answer a variety of questions and reworked system quotes until we were happy.The install team were excellent. They arrived early to setup for the install and the whole team were easy to deal with during the install.Customer service has been great as we had to delay our install due to roof repairs and they stayed in touch throughout. Emailed the energy provider directly after the install which was helpful.

Rk solar was knowledgeable and adaptable. We asked for , and received different panel quotes and configurations. From our accepting the quote to installation was fast, and they helped organised the grid connection. Very happy. Very satisfied.

Very impressed with Karan who took the time to come out and assess my steep roof. Other solar companies were only interested in doing quick deals over the phone, snare my deposit but not come out once they discovered the steep roof.The advice provided was patiently and expertly given and he answered my numerous questions about the Trina 440W panels and the Enphase IQ8HC microinverters promptly and professionally.I didn’t have to wait long for the installation (under a week) which was such a pleasant surprise and on the day of the installation, the installers were polite, friendly and professional.I love my Enphase Enlighten app which shows me real time info of how my panels and inverters are performing and I’m looking forward to seeing my next electricity bill in 2 months time.Thank you Karan and team for a great job done.

Quote was prompt and in person with detailed quotation sent the next day.  My questions were answered quickly and once accepted the system was booked for install the following week.  The installation team arrived on time, were polite and made sure I understood the operation of the app and system before leaving.  The follow up was great and they helped to apply for the upgrade to smart meter.  Great service all round.

After being assured that no contractors would be used, on the install day a company I had never heard of turned up to install my system. The workmen carried out a professional install in any case but a heads-up would have been appreciated.The workman didn’t seem to have good knowledge of the software for monitoring the system but between us we worked it out. At this point, though, we could not get all parts of the monitoring app to work.After work finished we paid the balance for the job and all was great! There was the small issue of the problem with the monitoring software which took a couple of weeks before it was finally fixed.Now everything is working great and our power bills are down to almost a third.In proceeding communications we were advised that there were some hiccups due to the extremely busy period and they have since addressed the communication issues.Great value for money. Very helpful guidance and advice in the lead up. Best price and great results in the end with promises of prompt ongoing support in the future.

Professional, communicative and punctual.The only minor issue we experienced was related to the metal leaf guard we had installed around our array.As our roof has undulating tiles, the leaf guard didn't fully block the 'valleys' in the tiles and would have been largely ineffective had we not done so subsequently ourselves.It would have been good if RK could have flagged this issue upfront and addressed it during the install.The install was done in a clean and timely manner and our first full quarter's bill shows the sort of savings we were hoping to achieve.

From the initial site visit to the install and after install follow up RK Solar were easy to deal with.They struck the right balance between cost and quality after taking the time to properly understand our situation and requirements.The sales agent was very knowledgeable and able answer all my questions and was very accomodating in building multiple quote scenarios for me.The installers did a great job, working efficiently and cleared away all packaging, materials etc leaving the house as it was when they arrived.
An easy install, and the onstallers took into account my preferences for positions which was very helpful

RK Solar were brilliant from the get go. They provided me with their quote straight away and were always prompt in replying to my many emails and the questions that I had.The battery I was considering getting was the Alpha ESS and RK Solar came up with the best price. Although the price was good, it wasn't my only consideration in going ahead with the purchase. I found the whole experience in dealing with them to be hassle free and painless. They were always professional and very knowledgeable.The installation was scheduled for December 5 and it went well. They turned up on the day and were on time. I was particularly pleased that they didn't have to run conduits along the external wall of the house to connect to my meter box as they managed to get under the house and run the cables through the wall cavity. It resulted in a much neater installation and saved me having to modify the post that supports my side gate. When the job was done they help me setup the Alpha app on my phone so I could monitor my solar system.However, the day after the installation I noticed there was an issue with the battery. The error light on the battery panel was on and the battery wasn't achieving full charge. It could only manage 10% charge no matter how sunny it was. I reported it RK Solar and they responded quickly and that they were investigating it. After a day I received another email from them stating that they have escalated the matter to Alpha and that they were awaitng a response. Alpha seemed to be dragging their feet in resolving the issue as it took them several days to respond. They eventually responded saying that they suspected the problem to be a communication issue with the battery.RK Solar contacted me to advise that they wanted to come over on Decmber 20 to fix the problem. Unfortunately, that date was not suitable as for us as I wanted to be present when they came. I asked them to reschedule it and the repair eventually took place on the January 15, hence this late review. I now have a fully functioning battery and solar system, very happy.I saw the electrician remove and replace an RJ45 connector from the battery so I guess Alpha was spot-on in their assessment that it was a communication problem.There was a hiccup in my battery installation process but overall the experience was positive.

This top review is for the service and response to a failure in a long operating system.My system had a failure, which caused normal troubleshooting to be problematic.I want to commend RK Solar for persistence and 3 visits with replacement parts before the problem was found and rectified.Technology can fail, and the true quality of the service can only be known at the end of the system's lifetime. I recommend RK Solar and would choose them again if I could go back in time.

These guys are outstanding and I could not be happier with the service and quality of product/installation provided by RK Solar & Consulting Services!We had our solar system installed by them back in April 2023. The response time receiving their quote was extremely quick and once we accepted they had our panels installed within 1-2 weeks. The panels look amazing and come with a 25 year warranty! Since the installation 9 months ago we've had absolutely no issues and no down time whatsoever. Everything is running as it should and we have at least halved our electricity bill.Thank you to Kunal and his team of experts for a wonderful experience and top quality workmanship!

I highly recommend this business. The sales and quoting process was handled very diligently and up to the mark. The installation was carried out on the specified date and was done very neatly and well supervised. Their customer service was outstanding. They helped with the grid connection after the installation and also with the app. I am so pleased with the service I have received from this business.
Every aspect of the design, installation and purchase was a pleasure.

Sales person very polite, knowledgeableInstallation as aboveCustomer service . Poor to average. I had to call for them to contact the electricity supplier to change the meter.The battery does not get used at night. two air conditioning units running at 22:00H and no battery usage. I will wait until the 03.01.24 when the meter will be changed and then see what happens .I have called 3 time to get this looked at and have been told the engineers are looking at it . this was on the 10.12.23 and now it is 29.12.23 and no calls to inform me of what the problem is .

We had requested on-site attendance before quotation, and RK was the only vendor of the three provided who were willing to do this before accepting a quote.After an initial scheduling hickup, Phill from RK Solar came out to look at the various roof-line options we had and make his recommendation. Phill was knowledgable, providing various options at several different price points. He provided several quote variations with different panel brands, both with various brands of batteries and without batteries. He also quoted options to use a solar hot water diverter or heat pump.We opted not to proceed with battery or hot water system changes at this time. The system he designed avoided the complexity of using the roof of our garage (external building with unknown conduit capacity) which was favoured by other vendors. He was also able to explain how the system could be extended in the future for when we are ready to add additional panels, a battery and/or EV to the mix. Phill was never pushy and was available to answer follow up questions.The installation was performed by a subcontracted company. That wasn't my preference, however I cannot fault the job that they did a great job on the day. The panels look good and the Envoy box was beautifully installed. Without prompting, they ran the wires internally and completely avoided the ugly conduits visible in many installs. The installation team also went above and beyond to help me trace the conduit path to my garage and suggested what I would need to do to facilitate usage of that roof for solar panels in the future or to install an EV charger. Everything was cleaned up afterwards and the panels have worked flawlessly.Their back office arranged with our retailer to upgrade our smart meter seamlessly. There was one mistake made in the invoice which (picked up the day before installation) They had listed the wrong panel brand, but this was all sorted out and the invoice was corrected and re-issued.
Using RK Solar was a great customer experience from quoting to post installation.

The whole experience from beginning to end was just so good. Multiple people involved (at least 6 personally) through the 4 or 5 stages and they all listened to what I wanted and delivered exactly what I asked for, a brilliant system, at a great price! 5 stars for sales/quoting and site visit, install - impeccable, communication, politeness, tidy, punctual, professional. THANK YOU!

The Salesperson came to my house on time, had clear and respectful answers to all my questions and was not pushy. They also answered questions I thought of later and emailed to them. The installers were on time, finished in the day and were polite and cleaned up after themselves.

They were quick to arrange an onsite visit before quoting, which made everything much easier. They went into a lot of detail to help us decide on the right system for us.On the day of the install the team leader was very polite and consulted with us every step of the way. Once installed, they took us through installation of the monitoring app and made sure all was good. They cleaned everything up before they were on their way. Their office submitted the smart meter install request first thing on the Monday.

Appointment arranged quickly, Hemaal talked me through the options and what he considered to be worthwhile. He always responded promptly when I had queries. The price was competitive compared to other quotes. Install was arranged quickly and completed efficiently.

Installation went ahead without a hitch. Only problem is the Inverter App which is still not working 100% and am still waiting for the fix after 10 days. Good job in general so would still recommend them.

The sales and Installation people were good. Prompt, efficient and flexible. The installation was delayed because we had to remove some plants but the installers were very helpful with that and the battery was installed with no other problems. They helped with registration and showing us which app to use. The problems started when we wanted to get the rebate and a Compliance Certificate. Several emails left with office went unanswered and when I rang I was told that the certificate would be emailed shortly and that the rebate would go live in November. That happened but when I went through the requirements for the rebate I saw I needed proof of purchase. So I emailed the admin whether the invoice was enough and when the certificate would come. I am still waiting for a reply. So I still don’t know if the invoice is Proof of Purchase and I still don’t have a Compliance Certificate.Update 20/11/2023: Once management was involved that the issue was resolved quickly.

RK Solar are a professional outfit who are matter of fact and not pushy. From initial contact, to onsite visit, installation scheduling, day of install, and go live, the process was straightforward. We discussed various systems and in the end decided to go with Enphase micro inverters on Jinko Solar 440W panels because of the fire safety aspect and not having an electrified roof. Our installers were setup from 7.30am and we were using solar power just after midday. While I haven't been up on the roof to see the panel array, the Enphase App clearly registers the performance of each of the 20 panels independently and collectively. On the brightest days the solar gain is in line with the quoted production. However, until Energy Australia install the new Smart Meter (which is meant to be within 15 business days) we won't know the return on investment because the FiT and power exported to the Grid isn't being credited. While it's a personal thing, I prefer to meet with the business in person and onsite to gauge their competency and diligence. That's why I felt comfortable with RK Solar in addition to the high quality spec for the installation materials they use. Others may be content to deal with an over-the-phone / email provider with remote aerial surveys of your roof. Each to their own.

The sales person came to our house and checked it out - it is a complex two story with an existing old system. They listened to what I wanted from the system, discussed options and quickly prepared the full quote online with me. They were extremely experienced and polite.I was pleased with the fast delivery - 1 week at peak time.The installer was also exceptional. Skilled, polite, efficient,asked questions about how we wanted it installed, tidy and fast. They also added value by offering bird mesh as our old system had pigeon problems.

Sales consultant was courteous and knowledgeable. He addressed a lot of our queries.They were quick to organise installation.Installer and his team were polite, punctual and efficient.Post installation admin support was great. They helped us promptly organised grid connection.

RK Solar provided the most detailed quote of all the solar companies, with many different options for size of install, inverter and panel type.Very happy with Kunal Kapoor, the Director of RK Solar and especially Karan Kapoor who personally visited our property and explained all the aspect of solar. He was helpful, knowledgeable, promptly returned calls, emails and made changes to the system spec and provided quotes as requested.RK Solar & Consulting Service are Enphase Professional installer. I was bit skeptical and concerned about installing the solar as you hear many horror stories of panels crossing the ridge line which causes the roof damage and panels catching fire, but Kunal from RK Solar with an experience of over 12 years and specially being an electrical engineering background and Karan with all the experience of the practical side of it made us feel safe.Once I paid my deposit, they processed my order and got back within a few days to lock in a date.The installation team turned up on the due date, were on time, friendly, courteous, clean / tidy and did a good job installing the products and provided with all the required installation certification paperwork. The installation was done in a day and was relatively smooth.Overall, my experience with Karan and Kunal from RK Solar has been very positive. I would have no issue recommending them based on my experiences with their pre / post sales teams and installation team.Many Thanks to RK Solar & Consulting Services.
Installers were punctual, polite and very tidy.Have had no further follow up from RK Solar Services.

I was impressed with RK from discussion with their sale rep Phil through to installation and closing out the administration with the energy provider company. The design for my solution, which involved shade, was the most logical provided to me and well explained.The price was competitive, slightly above one other quote  and considerably better than the first one I got, it appeared to me to be the best value option. Support throughout on questions about the solution and administration with the energy companies was great, all that admin work was covered by RK.They use a mix of company managed installers and contractors, whom they advised are a small group regularly working for them. My setup was installed by a contractor, I was bit concerned when they turned up about whether this would impact quality but was impressed with all elements of the installation, the neat work putting in the distribution board and the clean up at the end.Overall I'm really happy I went with RK and would recommend them.

I received quotes from multiple companies, including Solaray. However, RK Solar truly stood out for their exceptional professionalism. They conducted a thorough site visit, provided a clear and detailed quote, and their sales representative was not only friendly but also impressively remembered all the numbers and details. The installation process was executed with precision, politeness, and punctuality. Their customer service was so adept that I didn't have any concerns throughout the entire process – it all seemed to run seamlessly. I'm extremely satisfied with RK Solar. Moreover, the performance of the solar system in the first month of use has exceeded my expectations. To put it simply, I couldn't ask for more.
Great service, on time and friendly contractor. Quick and had system up and running in the afternoon.

Sales processes seemed very easy. Phill was on time and listened to what I wanted.  We discussed that the system was going to be shaded, and the brief was "as many panels as will fit on the roof, and the best placement for the sun"Install day arrived. The guys generally did a good job, with the following exceptions.No one explained that there was a box which needed to be put on the wall next to the meter (there is no good place next to the meter to put another box as we already have a Tesla gateway there). As a result, I dont have monitoring on consumption, and have to get the installers of my first solar install to come and put 2 extra CT's to the tesla gateway, but they are not interested as they were not asked to quote on the job (they have fallen to a sliver rated, so I did not ask them.) As a result the Tesla gateway is not able to see most of the new production (only one phase).The installers drilled a hole in the brick wall without checking what was behind it, then when explained they were drilling into the back of the fire place, they offered to silicone up the hole...They did not bring extra panels, so despite there being room for more, they could place none anyway.Now, after multiple phone calls, RK are not engaging as they dont want to come back out again for what might be 2 more panels.also not happy with the placement, as 4 panels are being shaded by a roof line up to an hour before they need to be. But again, they wont return calls to discuss.  Overall it felt like it was just slapped on the roof in the easiest way possible, rather than being placed for best sun.

In what feels like a minefield of options when considering selection, purchase and installation of a new solar power system we found RK Solar the perfect choice for first-timers seeking to thread a path through the extraordinary range of options and promises.From first contact via telephone to a meeting at home, discussions reviewing our particular location, to submission of a range of price/performance options specific to our needs, and subsequent installation, RK Solar managed each step in a very helpful and professional way.All bases covered and questions answered. I am now addicted to opening the app which provides current charge and usage data and, for once, look forward to receiving our power bill!A great job from start to finish.(BTW, system was installed about 10 days after signing the contract.)

RK solar got in touch with us promptly. They came out and inspected the house/roof and gave us some suggestions. We were happy to go ahead with them  after also obtaining a few quotes for other solar companies.Installation was booked pretty much after the deposit was paid. Installers were punctual and very efficient.After the installation, RK solar arranged for our energy provider to install a smart meter. The person who installed the meter seemed to have made a cut in one of the wiring. The RK solar electrician who initially installed the solar system came out and fixed the issue (went above and beyond and was gracious about it).
RK Solar handled all installation requirements. It went smoothly on the day and instructions on the solar app were very clear. Would recommend this company.

Great company from initial sales to installation. We have many shade areas and we were given an honest appraisal with great explanation for the best system. The price was very competitive and the electrical installation team were fantastic. Very happy, great service.

The quoting process from RK Solar was the most personal of all the quotes and I really felt the salesperson was very patient explaining all the options to me without pressuring me to decide on any particular system.  From feeling very overwhelmed at the start of the process, I felt much more confident in assessing what my needs were.  I also didn't feel that he was trying to sell me the most expensive system but was really considering all factors objectively in offering alternatives.  I am confident we have purchased the best system for our circumstances.The installation was straight forward with the guys being very polite and considerate.  It was all done in a day.Customer service was attentive and at all times I felt that everything was under control.The system is working better than I thought it would!

RK Solar installed 15 panels on our roof at Kellyville on 16 Aug 23. Their consultant took the time to visit the property before quoting and this provided us with greater confidence than companies who quote from a satellite photo. Installation went smoothly.

RK were great. The gentleman that came to our house was very knowledgeable and very professional. We are yet to finish the process with the installation of a smart meter but RK have been so proactive in ensuring we have a positive outcome

RK Solar came out to the house to do a full inspection and quote on the best solar option for us. They readily answered our questions and explained everything clearly.  The written quote was easy to follow and understand, with different product and pricing options given. The installation went very smoothly. The team were very polite and courteous. They explained the enphase app to us, and told us the grid connection had been arranged with our energy provider.My only complaint is that the app failed the following day, and it took 2 weeks for them to come back to fix it. They said it would not impact our electricity bill though.

Sales person came onsite prepared multiple options. Installation was conducted by a team that has a mantra that they work as if they are working on their own home. Very neat job. The grid connection was organised within a couple of days. Customer service is very responsive and has also updated the inverter firmware.

Edit 20/10/23: "After my feedback, RK Solar got in touch with me and explained the reason for their delay. They have followed a couple of times and provided technical details. Vendor pushed firmware update and since then the production seems to be okay for the capacity of the system and direction of the panels. They have been professional with their support. I would recommend them"Sales process was smooth. Sales person took us through details. I use the questionnaire from SolarQuotes. One thing I wanted to 100% avoid was usage of subcontractor and the sale person assure me that "they only use their own engineers that are all employee of RK Solar". No, they don't. The sales person also assure me that they will remove our TV antenna (which I supplied photo of its screw on the tile and he confirmed they would remove it at no cost but they will not take it with them. I agreed)On the day of installation, it was rainy. They show up early in the morning and they proceed with install. I asked them are you guys RK employees, the electrician smiled and said "who told you that.  We are subcontractors". I was not happy with this at all. The roofer didn't know anything about TV antenna removal and he told me it will cost me extra. I noticed they tear roof sarking in a number of places and specifically asked them to repair it before they finish. The installation went ahead. I end up paying extra for changing the switch board and recycling the TV antenna.
